props.text:
BTC low-80s range highs analysis

Market structure commentary: Shorting BTC at low-80s highs will be attempted by many but won't work smoothly (not like May). Shorts will face early profit-taking, need active babysitting, or face liquidation.

Recommendation: Transition to bullish positioning ("green side").

Charts show BTC consolidating at 365D RVWAP ~81.2K with multi-VWAP base-build framework; ETH above 365D RVWAP at 2,836K with different structural picture (ethereum's cycle coming).

Aligns with group structural bull thesis (KillaXBT +30% swing, Stoiiic VWAP pivots, consolidation view).
